en: Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-illuminating and non-visible, a phenomenon that is non-illuminating and non-visible arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-illuminating and non-visible, a phenomenon that is non-non-illuminating and non-non-visible arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-illuminating and non-visible, phenomena that are both non-illuminating and non-visible and non-non-illuminating and non-non-visible arise by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to cause, three; with respect to object, one ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
